findings.title: Fail-open default for CSP `unsafe-eval`
findings.desc: `allowUnsafeEval` defaults to `process.env.NODE_ENV !== "production"`, so any misconfigured or non-standard deployment where `NODE_ENV` isn't exactly `"production"` (unset, `"staging"`, custom build scripts, etc.) silently weakens the CSP by adding `'unsafe-eval'` in production. A security-relevant default should fail closed (default to the strict policy) rather than fail open based on an easily-misconfigured env var.

findings.title: Comment references undefined constant
findings.desc: The updated comment cites `MAX_OVERRIDE_QUERIES (5)` and "≤3 queries" for the LLM path, but neither `MAX_OVERRIDE_QUERIES` nor a cap of 3 is defined or visible in this file (the LLM path slices to 3, but the override cap isn't declared here), making the safety justification unverifiable/misleading to a reader of this file alone.
